svg.title: SPY 2026-09-09 orbit
svg.desc: Orbit of SPY on 2026-09-09: horizontal is price velocity, vertical is price acceleration, from a centred Savitzky-Golay fit of 11 observations, degree 3, one-minute spacing, 5 observations lost at each edge of each run. 380 observations drawn in time order; the path is not closed. Colour is the note each observation quantised to, thirty degrees of hue per semitone from A. Axes are scaled to this session's own extremes; this is a preview, not a fixed scale.
svg.text: SPY · 2026-09-09 · velocity × acceleration · 380 observations · preview scaling
